subject: Executive sponsor activation & EB meeting bookings — MAP + evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive sponsor activation & EB meeting bookings — MAP + evaluation timeline

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the two-week evaluation window and the exec briefing (EB) cadence we discussed. High level ask: can we lock a 60–90 minute EB slot with your exec sponsor + procurement availability the week of Apr 4 so we can finalize T&Cs and confirm the dedicated capacity baseline?

Attached: RWX-Map-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), and I’m including an .ics for proposed EB windows.

Quick proposal (high level):
- Week of Mar 28: technical eval (SRE/infra), 2 half-day sessions
- Week of Apr 4: Exec Briefing (60–90m) + procurement alignment
- Apr 11: final commitment & contract signature target

Can you confirm: primary exec sponsor, best dates for an EB the week of Apr 4, and whether procurement needs any additional docs up-front?

I’ve cc’d Marissa (customer lead) to help lock the calendar and Ben for SLAs/pricing nuance.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RWX-Map-v1.xlsx (map draft)
From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor activation & EB meeting bookings — MAP + evaluation timeline

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Exec sponsor: Maya Patel (Head of Platform) — she is available afternoons PT on Apr 5 or Apr 7.
- Procurement: looped in (procurement@acme.com) — they’ll need our standard security profile + a short SOW describing data handling and retention.
- Technical eval: we like the two half-day sessions; can you confirm an agenda?

I’ll also confirm with Maya which of the two EB times works better. If Apr 5 afternoon is open for you all, that’s my first preference.

--Chris

On attachments: please send the SOW and the short security one-pager up front.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor activation & EB meeting bookings — MAP + evaluation timeline

Looping in to coordinate on internal prep. Notes from Chris: Maya Patel (exec sponsor) prefers Apr 5 or Apr 7 afternoon. Procurement wants security profile + SOW. Action items for us before we propose slots: 
- Ben: prepare pricing/commitment options (reserved baseline + burst) and an SLA summary.
- Rishi: pull the SOC2 + network diagram and a 1-page data-retention statement we can hand to procurement.
- Stephanie/Marissa: finalize MAP with specific owners for each eval task and send to Acme by EOD tomorrow so they can review ahead of the EB.

I’ll draft a short EB agenda (60–90m) and share proposed Zoom times.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@acme.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor activation & EB meeting bookings — MAP + evaluation timeline

Thanks Chris —

Attaching a cleaned MAP (RWX-Map-v1.xlsx) with owners and a proposed EB agenda below. I also uploaded a short SOW and security one-pager to the shared Drive link (see below). Please review and let us know which EB window (Apr 5 2–3:30pm PT or Apr 7 3–4:30pm PT) works best for Maya and the procurement team.

Proposed EB agenda (60–90m):
1) 10m: Introductions & success criteria (Maya + Stephanie)
2) 20m: Performance/cost baseline & dedicated capacity ask (Ben)
3) 20m: Security/compliance and data handling (Rishi)
4) 20m: Rollout/runbook + support SLAs (Marissa)
5) 10m: Open questions and next steps (contract owner + procurement)

Attachments: RWX-Map-v1.xlsx, EB-meeting-availability.ics
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0A1b2C3d/ACME-MAP
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/record/ACME-3421

If Apr 5 2–3:30pm PT works for Maya, we’ll lock that and send calendar invites + a short pre-read (MAP + SOW).

Best,
Stephanie

From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Executive sponsor activation & EB meeting bookings — MAP + evaluation timeline

On Tue, Mar 23, 2027 at 08:30 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> If Apr 5 2–3:30pm PT works for Maya, we’ll lock that and send calendar invites + a short pre-read (MAP + SOW).

Stephanie / team —

Apr 5 2–3:30pm PT is confirmed for Maya and myself. Procurement (procurement@acme.com) will join for the first 30 minutes; I’ve asked them to review the drive link and the security one-pager ahead of the call.

Next steps on our side: Maya will assign a success criteria owner and we’ll send an internal pre-read to the exec + procurement by Fri EOD. Please send the final MAP and SOW to procurement@acme.com and cc me.

Thanks — looking forward to the EB.

- Chris
